topic: Mango season: waiting patiently for the mangoes to ripen.

episode.title: Mano aur Sheru: Sabr Ka Meetha Aam

shots.narration: ارے مانو، یہ ہرا آم ابھی کھاؤ گی؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, colourful Pakistani courtyard beside a neem tree, low table with a basket of green mangoes, rounded 3D family animation, soft sunlight, no text.
shots.action: Mano raises a green mango toward her open mouth.
shots.mood: Playful suspense, wide blue eyes and lifted ears.

shots.narration: شیرو نے کہا، ابھی رکو، یہ آم کچا ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard beside the mango basket, rounded 3D family animation, soft sunlight, no text.
shots.action: Sheru gently places one paw between Mano's mouth and the mango.
shots.mood: Kind concern, relaxed faces and friendly rounded shapes.

shots.narration: [surprised] کچا؟ مانو نے تو میٹھا آم سمجھا تھا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard table with green mangoes, rounded 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano turns the green mango over in her paws.
shots.mood: Curious surprise, tilted head and round blue eyes.

shots.narration: شیرو بولا، انہیں پکنے کے لیے کچھ وقت چاہیے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, shaded courtyard table near an open kitchen doorway, mango basket visible, rounded 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru points toward the basket of green mangoes.
shots.mood: Reassuring warmth, gentle smile and attentive kitten.

shots.narration: مانو نے آم واپس ٹوکری میں رکھ دیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, shaded courtyard table with a shallow woven mango basket, rounded 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano places her green mango back in the basket.

shots.narration: [sighs] مگر مانو کو انتظار بہت لمبا لگ رہا تھا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard floor beside the shaded mango table, rounded 3D family animation, warm afternoon light, no text.
shots.action: Mano rests her chin on both paws beside the table.
shots.mood: Gentle impatience, floppy posture and wistful eyes.

shots.narration: شیرو بولا، آؤ، تب تک گیند سے کھیلتے ہیں۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, open courtyard beneath the neem tree, mango table in the shaded background, rounded 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru rolls a plain red ball toward Mano.
shots.mood: Inviting playfulness, perked ears and bright colours.

shots.narration: مانو کھیلنے لگی تو انتظار آسان ہو گیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Pakistani courtyard with patterned floor tiles and a neem tree, rounded 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano bats the red ball back toward Sheru.
shots.mood: Cheerful friendship, lively kitten and smiling dog.

shots.narration: [excited] کچھ دن بعد آم پیلے ہو گئے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same shaded courtyard table several days later, basket now holding yellow mangoes, rounded 3D family animation, soft morning light, no text.
shots.action: Mano rises onto her hind paws to inspect the yellow mangoes.
shots.mood: Delighted discovery, sparkling blue eyes and upright ears.

shots.narration: اب آموں سے کتنی پیاری خوشبو آ رہی تھی!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard table with ripe yellow mangoes in a woven basket, rounded 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru leans toward a ripe mango to sniff it.
shots.mood: Quiet satisfaction, softly closed eyes and relaxed ears.

shots.narration: میٹھا آم کھا کر مانو خوش ہو گئی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard picnic mat with a plain plate of peeled mango pieces without stones, ripe basket behind, rounded 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano takes a small bite from a mango piece.
shots.mood: Sweet delight, happy kitten and warmly smiling friend.

shots.narration: [excited] صبر کا پھل میٹھا ہوتا ہے، اگلی بار چھت کی سیر!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard picnic mat beside an enclosed rooftop stairway, mango plate in foreground, rounded 3D family animation, golden sunlight, no text.
shots.action: Mano points toward the rooftop stairway.

episode.endHook: اگلی بار مانو اور شیرو کے ساتھ چھت کی سیر!
episode.description: مانو آم فوراً کھانا چاہتی ہے، مگر آم ابھی کچے ہیں! شیرو کے ساتھ انتظار کرکے اسے پتا چلتا ہے کہ صبر کا پھل واقعی میٹھا ہوتا ہے۔
